Added: The browser tab names the repo, page and what's open, shortened so several tabs stay readable (e.g. "ext · PRs · #1800"); a repo's short name is its first word, cut to 3 letters when long.

whats_new.title: Browser tabs say where you are
whats_new.text: Each dashboard tab in your browser now shows the repo, the page and what's open, shortened: for example "ext · PRs · #1800" or "aegis · Studio · Fix the export". Switching repos updates it.
